description: Shared hooks for all AI agents. Each agent reads this differently — see README.

pre-pr.description: Report SonarCloud status before PR creation without blocking delivery
pre-pr.check: Run `pnpm sonar` when credentials and the local environment are available; otherwise rely on CI and record the limitation in the PR
pre-pr.block_message: SonarCloud is advisory for this repository. Keep the result visible and document any unavailable or failing scan; do not block PR creation.
